paper_title: DLP Dynamic Layerwise Pruning in Large Language Models
caption: Perplexity of LLaMA1-7B on different validation datasets under varying quantization bits.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата представя perplexity на LLaMA1-7B върху различни валидационни набори данни при различни битове на квантуване. Хоризонталната ос е етикетирана като "Quantization Bits" и показва стойности 3, 4, 8 и 16, следващи ред в посока от ляво надясно. Вертикалната ос е етикетирана като "Perplexity" и показва стойности от 0 до 30 с равномерни интервали. Данните са представени като стълбове, всеки от които съответства на определен брой битове на квантуване. За всяка стойност на битовете на квантуване има два стълба: единият е обозначен с оранжево и етикетиран като "Ours", а другият е обозначен със синьо и етикетиран като "Wiki/PTB". За стойността на битовете на квантуване 3, стълбът "Ours" показва perplexity от приблизително 18, докато стълбът "Wiki/PTB" показва стойност от приблизително 23. За стойността на битовете на квантуване 16, стълбът "Ours" показва perplexity от приблизително 22, а стълбът "Wiki/PTB" показва стойност от приблизително 22. Стълбовете са подредени по нарастване на стойностите на квантуването.
model_annotations.English:
Here's a paragraph describing the bar charts, following your instructions:

The three bar charts illustrate the perplexity values for two methods, labeled "Uniform" and "Ours," across different quantization bit settings on three validation datasets: WikiText, PTB, and C4. In each chart, the horizontal axis represents the quantization bits, ranging from 3 to 16, with values incrementing by 1. The vertical axis is labeled "Perplexity" and displays values on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to approximately 30 for the WikiText and C4 datasets, and 0 to 400 for the PTB dataset. Tick labels are present at regular intervals of 10 on the vertical axis. Each chart contains two sets of bars, one for "Uniform" and one for "Ours," differentiated by color: "Uniform" is represented by blue bars, and "Ours" is represented by orange bars. For the WikiText dataset, the shortest "Uniform" bar at 3 quantization bits has a value of approximately 28, while the tallest "Uniform" bar at 16 quantization bits has a value of approximately 27. The shortest "Ours" bar at 3 quantization bits has a value of approximately 22, and the tallest "Ours" bar at 16 quantization bits has a value of approximately 25. For the PTB dataset, the shortest "Uniform" bar at 3 quantization bits has a value of approximately 310, while the tallest "Uniform" bar at 16 quantization bits has a value of approximately 320. The shortest "Ours" bar at 3 quantization bits has a value of approximately 160, and the tallest "Ours" bar at 16 quantization bits has a value of approximately 180. For the C4 dataset, the shortest "Uniform" bar at 3 quantization bits has a value of approximately 26, while the tallest "Uniform" bar at 16 quantization bits has a value of approximately 25. The shortest "Ours" bar at 3 quantization bits has a value of approximately 12, and the tallest "Ours" bar at 16 quantization bits has a value of approximately 20. The bars are sorted in ascending order based on the quantization bits. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm stellt die Perplexität des LLaMA1-7B-Modells auf verschiedenen Validierungsdatensätzen unter Verwendung verschiedener Quantisierungsbits dar. Die horizontale Achse stellt die Quantisierungsbits dar, die von 3 bis 16 reichen, wobei die Werte 3, 4, 8 und 16 dargestellt werden. Die vertikale Achse stellt die Perplexität mit einer linearen Skala dar, die von 0 bis 30 reicht. Die Tick-Beschriftungen sind in Intervallen von 5 auf der Perplexitätsskala verteilt. Es gibt zwei Datensätze, die durch farbige Balkengruppen dargestellt werden: "Uniform" (orange) und "Ours" (blau). Für den Datensatz "Uniform" hat der Balken für 3 Quantisierungsbits eine Höhe von etwa 20, der Balken für 4 Quantisierungsbits eine Höhe von etwa 18, der Balken für 8 Quantisierungsbits eine Höhe von etwa 15 und der Balken für 16 Quantisierungsbits eine Höhe von etwa 13. Für den Datensatz "Ours" hat der Balken für 3 Quantisierungsbits eine Höhe von etwa 300, der Balken für 4 Quantisierungsbits eine Höhe von etwa 280, der Balken für 8 Quantisierungsbits eine Höhe von etwa 250 und der Balken für 16 Quantisierungsbits eine Höhe von etwa 230. Die Balken sind nicht sortiert, aber die Balkengruppen für "Uniform" und "Ours" unterliegen einer konsistenten Abnahme in ihren Werten mit zunehmenden Quantisierungsbits und werden in der Reihenfolge der Quantisierungsbitwerte visuell dargestellt.
